title: Tiny, cute spinning top
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow glow under top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='24' ry='6' fill='#2b1a44'/>
  <!-- spinning motion swooshes -->
  <path d='M22 62 Q34 70 50 70 Q66 70 78 62' fill='none' stroke='#7be3ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M26 72 Q38 78 50 78 Q62 78 74 72' fill='none' stroke='#7be3ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.45'/>
  <!-- body cone -->
  <path d='M50 40 L74 66 Q72 78 50 78 Q28 78 26 66 Z' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <!-- lower shading for edge -->
  <path d='M50 64 Q66 64 74 66 Q72 78 50 78 Q28 78 26 66 Z' fill='#d63b7f'/>
  <!-- stripe band -->
  <path d='M32 56 Q50 62 68 56 Q70 62 66 66 Q50 71 34 66 Q30 62 32 56 Z' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- cap / lid -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='24' ry='9' fill='#7be3ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='24' ry='9' fill='#bff4ff'/>
  <!-- cap shine highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='36' rx='8' ry='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- little stem knob -->
  <rect x='47' y='24' width='6' height='8' rx='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='23' r='5' fill='#ff9f45'/>
  <!-- tiny cute eyes on cap -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='39' r='2.4' fill='#22335c'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='39' r='2.4' fill='#22335c'/>
  <circle cx='43.8' cy='38.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57.8' cy='38.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 43 Q50 46 54 43' fill='none' stroke='#22335c' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- side glow dots (sparkles) -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='52' r='2.2' fill='#bff4ff'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='50' r='2.8' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='70' r='1.8' fill='#bff4ff'/>
</svg>
